data.one_liner: Configure and define dynamic variables and UI banners for different app flavors.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to quickly set up environment configurations (such as development, testing, and production) with custom variables and visual banners. It exposes a FlavorConfig for global variables and a FlavorBanner widget to visually indicate the current flavor on screen.
use_when: You need to manage different app environments like dev, test, and production
You want to display visual flavor banners on your app UI
You need to store and access flavor-specific variables like base URLs
avoid_when: You require deep native-level flavor configurations in Android/iOS build systems without runtime helpers
You are already using an alternative configuration and state setup that covers your environments
strengths: Provides an easy-to-use FlavorBanner widget out of the box
Allows defining arbitrary environment variables per flavor
weaknesses: Does not handle native platform-level flavor setup automatically in recent versions
data.setup_notes: Initialize FlavorConfig in main and wrap your app or MaterialApp in FlavorBanner.
